授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course aims to develop the ability to read,  about abridged texts on ethical theories, and consider those theories' principles in relation to some real life problems often discussed in the mass media. In this course, students will learn and be tested in their knowledge of both specialized academic and general English vocabulary used in these texts and articles. Students will also learn how to gather and critically discuss information on ethical issues important in modern society, and write a long essay on one of those issues.
